proposals.text:
Thanks — I can proceed, but I can’t look up accounts by phone number from here.

Per our procedures I can only look you up by one of:
- full name (case‑sensitive, exactly as on the account), OR
- Rho‑Bank user ID, OR
- email address on file.

Please provide one of those so I can perform the lookup. Once you give that, the two verification fields you already provided (date of birth 11/03/1990 and phone number 312-555-0481) are fine for verification — I’ll confirm they match, log the verification time, and then investigate your Gold Rewards Card and EcoCard rewards posting.

If you don’t want to or can’t provide any of those here, you can instead:
- Call 1-800-RHO-BANK, or
- Use secure chat in the Rho‑Bank mobile app

Tell me which lookup method you’ll use and provide the identifier (or tell me you prefer one of the alternate contact options), and I’ll continue.
